Personal seat, not fund money (decisions.md D4): Ikigai Alpha is Loris.ai, the company Nancy Lublin spun out of Crisis Text Line; its $2M seed of February 2018 was led by Ann Miura-Ko with Kapor Capital, Omidyar Network, Homebrew and others, and names no Bessemer fund. Rob Stavis sat on the board in his own capacity; the company is not on the firm's list or his deal-partner map.

Personal investment, not fund money (decisions.md D4): Assembly OSM's $38M Series A of July 2022 was led by Fifth Wall Climate and Rob Stavis as an individual, and the announcement names no Bessemer fund; the company is not on the firm's list or his deal-partner map.

Sale consideration (Erik 2026-09-22): the Bessemer vehicle on the filings (Bessemer Venture Partners GMS, then Bessemer Venture Partners IV) held stock issued on 4 November 1997, when the listed Gentle Dental Service Corporation merged the private GMS Dental Group into itself and issued about 4,548,200 shares for all of GMS's stock. The investment was GMS Dental Group (its holders, Sprout, Accel and Bessemer Venture Partners GMS, appear in the 1998 proxy), which is the row the base should carry; no Bessemer fund bought a round of Gentle Dental itself.

Control position (COLLECTION.md control addendum, decisions.md D5): GFI Software S.A. is the Luxembourg holding company of TeamViewer and GFI (the firm lists it as LogicNow (GFI); the same SEC registrant as the base row logicnow). Its own F-1 says funds affiliated with Insight acquired control of the registrant in July 2009, when it became the parent of TeamViewer; the Bessemer funds were co-investors in that buyout through TeamViewer Holdings beside Insight and Greenspring, and the firm's own BVP Forge post names TeamViewer among its companies that fit a growth buyout structure. A control acquisition by the co-investor group is not a venture round. The position is also the same investment as the listed rows teamviewer and logicnow.

Control position (COLLECTION.md control addendum, decisions.md D5): WS Holdco is WiredScore (chief executive Arie Barendrecht on the filing; the firm lists it as WiredScore, base row wiredscore). Bessemer's first entry, in October 2017, was the purchase of a majority interest by an investor group led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Fifth Wall, which bought out Jared Kushner's stake; the trade press reported it as the group acquiring WiredScore. The issuer is a holding company incorporated in 2017 for that purchase. A transaction in which the firm and its co-investor group take control is not a venture round, and the 2018 Series A came after it.
